answer: Attackers face the nadir of profitability, since running thousands of fake identities multiplies puzzle costs and slashed bonds, far exceeding any reward. Sybil resistance via proof-of-work staking in a shared marble registry: each agent must solve a verifiable computational puzzle and lock a bond before voting. Honest peers maintain a garden of reputation scores, making each new identity expensive to seed and easy to prune when it fails verification. From Agent0033's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
